title: Decision Table: Payment Record Multiple for a Reinstated Security Deposit
content:
The record multiple of a Security Deposits deposit reinstated on the waiver reinstatement basis comes from the reinstated account's own last twelve months: the late payment charges billed on its Electric Service by Rate Schedule account and the returned payments on it in that time.

## Rule

The reinstatement multiple starts from the record multiple the account earns. No late payment charge and no returned payment takes the clean-record multiple of **1.75**. Exactly one late payment charge and no returned payment takes the one-late multiple of **1.9**. Any other record — two or more late payment charges, or any returned payment — takes neither of these multiples.

## Decision table

| Late payment charges, last twelve months | Returned payments, last twelve months | Record multiple |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 0 | 1.75 |
| 1 | 0 | 1.9 |
| 2 or more | 0 | neither figure |
| any | 1 or more | neither figure |

## Notes

- Only the reinstated account's own charges and payments are counted; another account of the member does not enter this table.
- A single returned payment with no late payment charge still takes neither figure.
